<style>
h1.title {
display: none;
}

.gb-bingo-card-shell {
background: #ffffff;
border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28);
border-radius: 22px;
padding: clamp(10px, 2vw, 20px);
box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
width: 100%;
max-width: 862px;
margin: 0 auto;
box-sizing: border-box;
}

.gb-bingo-preview-wrap {
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: flex-start;
width: 100%;
padding: 0 6px 8px;
box-sizing: border-box;
}

.gb-bingo-card {
--card-scale: 1;
--grid-size: 640px;
width: 100%;
max-width: 820px;
aspect-ratio: 820 / 1061;
background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fbff 100%);
border: max(1px, calc(2px * var(--card-scale))) solid #0f172a;
padding: calc(24px * var(--card-scale)) calc(24px * var(--card-scale)) calc(18px * var(--card-scale));
color: #0f172a;
display: grid;
grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
gap: calc(14px * var(--card-scale));
box-sizing: border-box;
}

.gb-bingo-card__header,
.gb-bingo-card__footer {
display: flex;
justify-content: space-between;
align-items: flex-start;
gap: calc(12px * var(--card-scale));
}

.gb-bingo-card__footer {
align-items: flex-end;
min-height: max(10px, calc(26px * var(--card-scale)));
}

.gb-bingo-card__eyebrow {
margin: 0;
font-size: clamp(6px, calc(12.48px * var(--card-scale)), 12.48px);
font-weight: 700;
line-height: 1.15;
letter-spacing: 0.02em;
color: #475569;
text-transform: capitalize;
}

.gb-bingo-card__title {
margin: 0;
font-size: clamp(10px, calc(23.2px * var(--card-scale)), 23.2px);
font-weight: 800;
line-height: 1.05;
letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.gb-bingo-card__logo,
.gb-bingo-card__footer-logo {
display: block;
object-fit: contain;
opacity: 0.4;
filter: grayscale(100%);
flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.gb-bingo-card__logo {
width: clamp(24px, calc(68px * var(--card-scale)), 68px);
height: clamp(24px, calc(68px * var(--card-scale)), 68px);
}

.gb-bingo-card__main {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
overflow: hidden;
}

.gb-bingo-grid-frame {
width: var(--grid-size);
height: var(--grid-size);
max-width: 100%;
max-height: 100%;
display: flex;
align-items: stretch;
justify-content: stretch;
}

.gb-bingo-grid {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
grid-template-rows: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
border: max(1px, calc(2px * var(--card-scale))) solid #0f172a;
background: #ffffff;
}

.gb-bingo-cell {
border-right: max(1px, calc(1.5px * var(--card-scale))) solid #0f172a;
border-bottom: max(1px, calc(1.5px * var(--card-scale))) solid #0f172a;
padding: max(4px, calc(12px * var(--card-scale)));
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
background: #ffffff;
overflow: hidden;
box-sizing: border-box;
min-width: 0;
min-height: 0;
position: relative;
}

.gb-bingo-cell:nth-child(5n) {
border-right: none;
}

.gb-bingo-cell:nth-last-child(-n + 5) {
border-bottom: none;
}

.gb-bingo-cell--free {
background: #eff6ff;
}

.gb-bingo-cell__fitbox {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
overflow: hidden;
min-width: 0;
min-height: 0;
}

.gb-bingo-cell__word {
display: inline-block;
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
font-weight: 800;
font-size: calc(26px * var(--card-scale));
line-height: 1.04;
letter-spacing: -0.02em;
text-align: center;
white-space: nowrap;
word-break: keep-all;
overflow-wrap: normal;
hyphens: none;
transform-origin: center center;
transform: scale(var(--fit-scale, 1));
max-width: none;
text-rendering: geometricPrecision;
}

.gb-bingo-cell__word--phrase {
display: block;
width: 100%;
white-space: normal;
overflow-wrap: break-word;
word-break: normal;
line-height: 1.02;
}

.gb-bingo-card__footer-brand {
display: inline-flex;
align-items: center;
gap: calc(8px * var(--card-scale));
font-size: clamp(6px, calc(11.52px * var(--card-scale)), 11.52px);
line-height: 1.1;
font-weight: 700;
color: #475569;
opacity: 0.72;
text-align: right;
}

.gb-bingo-card__footer-logo {
width: clamp(8px, calc(18px * var(--card-scale)), 18px);
height: clamp(8px, calc(18px * var(--card-scale)), 18px);
}

.gb-generator-grid {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
gap: 14px;
align-items: end;
}

.gb-generator-grid__count {
min-width: 170px;
}

.gb-config-note {
margin-top: 12px;
color: #64748b;
font-size: 0.84rem;
line-height: 1.5;
}

.gb-pdf-render-stage {
position: fixed;
left: -99999px;
top: 0;
width: 100%;
max-width: 862px;
padding: 0;
margin: 0;
pointer-events: none;
opacity: 0;
contain: layout style paint;
box-sizing: border-box;
}

.gb-bingo-empty {
padding: 36px 18px;
text-align: center;
color: #64748b;
font-style: italic;
}

.gb-label-with-tip {
display: inline-flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 8px;
}

.gb-label-with-tip .gb-field__label {
margin: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
.gb-generator-grid {
grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}

.gb-generator-grid__count {
min-width: 0;
}
}

.gb-bingo-cell--selected {
background: rgba(255, 191, 0, 0.6);
}
</style>

<script>
const BINGO_CONFIG = {
allowedWordsWithDifficultyUrl: 'https://kameronyork.com/datasets/conference-bingo-allowed-words-with-difficulty.json',
logoUrl: 'https://www.mygospelbuddy.com/assets/img/gospel-buddy-icon.png',
defaultDifficulty: 'easy',
defaultUseFreeSpace: true,
maxPdfCards: 10,
difficultyLabels: new Set(['easy', 'medium', 'hard'])
};

const state = {
wordEntries: [],
wordPools: {
easy: [],
medium: [],
hard: [],
random: []
},
metadata: {},
currentCard: null,
ready: false
};

const elements = {};
let fitRaf = null;
let cardResizeObserver = null;

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
cacheElements();
bindEvents();
prepareWordData().catch((error) => {
console.error(error);
setStatus('error', 'Gospel Buddy could not load the precomputed bingo word list. Please try refreshing the page.');
});
});

function cacheElements() {
elements.difficulty = document.getElementById('bingoDifficulty');
elements.useFreeSpace = document.getElementById('bingoUseFreeSpace');
elements.pdfCount = document.getElementById('bingoPdfCount');
elements.generate = document.getElementById('bingoGenerateButton');
elements.printSheets = document.getElementById('bingoPrintSheetsButton');
elements.reset = document.getElementById('bingoResetButton');
elements.status = document.getElementById('bingoStatus');
elements.summary = document.getElementById('bingoSummary');
elements.difficultyNote = document.getElementById('bingoDifficultyNote');
elements.printArea = document.getElementById('bingoPrintArea');
elements.pdfStage = document.getElementById('pdfRenderStage');
}

function bindEvents() {
elements.generate.addEventListener('click', () => generateAndRenderCard(true));
elements.difficulty.addEventListener('change', updateDifficultyNote);
elements.printSheets.addEventListener('click', exportPdfBatch);
elements.reset.addEventListener('click', resetSettings);
window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleLiveCardLayout);
}

async function prepareWordData() {
setStatus('info', 'Loading precomputed bingo word pools…', true);

const response = await fetch(BINGO_CONFIG.allowedWordsWithDifficultyUrl, {
cache: 'no-cache',
credentials: 'omit'
});

if (!response.ok) {
throw new Error(`Allowed word list request failed with status ${response.status}`);
}

const config = await response.json();
initializeWordPools(config);

elements.difficulty.value = BINGO_CONFIG.defaultDifficulty;
elements.useFreeSpace.checked = BINGO_CONFIG.defaultUseFreeSpace;
elements.pdfCount.value = '1';
updateDifficultyNote();

state.ready = true;
elements.printSheets.disabled = false;

setStatus('success', 'Precomputed bingo word pools are ready.');
generateAndRenderCard(false);
}

function initializeWordPools(config) {
const allowedWords = Array.isArray(config && config.allowedWords) ? config.allowedWords : [];
state.metadata = (config && typeof config.metadata === 'object' && config.metadata) ? config.metadata : {};

const seen = new Set();
const entries = [];

for (const item of allowedWords) {
let word = '';
let difficulty = 'random';
let stats = {};

if (typeof item === 'string') {
word = item;
} else if (item && typeof item === 'object') {
word = item.word;
difficulty = item.difficulty || 'random';
stats = item;
}

word = String(word || '').trim().toLowerCase();
difficulty = String(difficulty || '').trim().toLowerCase();

if (!word || seen.has(word)) {
continue;
}

if (!BINGO_CONFIG.difficultyLabels.has(difficulty)) {
difficulty = 'hard';
}

seen.add(word);
entries.push({
word,
difficulty,
stats
});
}

if (entries.length === 0) {
throw new Error('The precomputed allowed word list is empty.');
}

state.wordEntries = entries;
state.wordPools = {
easy: entries.filter((entry) => entry.difficulty === 'easy'),
medium: entries.filter((entry) => entry.difficulty === 'medium'),
hard: entries.filter((entry) => entry.difficulty === 'hard'),
random: entries.slice()
};
}


function updateDifficultyNote() {
const selectedDifficulty = elements.difficulty ? elements.difficulty.value : BINGO_CONFIG.defaultDifficulty;
const explanations = {
easy: 'Easy words have a 97% or higher likelihood of appearing in any talk in a given session.',
medium: 'Medium words have a 65% to under 97% likelihood of appearing in any talk in a given session.',
hard: 'Hard words have a 0% to under 65% likelihood of appearing in any talk in a given session.',
random: 'Random uses every allowed word, regardless of how likely it is to appear in any talk in a given session.'
};

if (elements.difficultyNote) {
elements.difficultyNote.textContent = explanations[selectedDifficulty] || explanations.easy;
}
}

function getSettings() {
return {
difficulty: elements.difficulty.value || BINGO_CONFIG.defaultDifficulty,
useFreeSpace: elements.useFreeSpace.checked,
pdfCount: clampNumber(elements.pdfCount.value, 1, BINGO_CONFIG.maxPdfCards, 1)
};
}

function resetSettings() {
elements.difficulty.value = BINGO_CONFIG.defaultDifficulty;
elements.useFreeSpace.checked = BINGO_CONFIG.defaultUseFreeSpace;
elements.pdfCount.value = '1';
updateDifficultyNote();
generateAndRenderCard(false);
}

function clampNumber(value, min, max, fallback) {
const numeric = Number(value);
if (!Number.isFinite(numeric)) {
return fallback;
}
return Math.min(Math.max(Math.round(numeric), min), max);
}

function getDifficultyPool(difficulty) {
if (difficulty === 'random') {
return state.wordPools.random || [];
}

return state.wordPools[difficulty] || state.wordPools.easy || [];
}

function shuffle(items) {
const copy = [...items];
for (let index = copy.length - 1; index > 0; index -= 1) {
const swapIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * (index + 1));
[copy[index], copy[swapIndex]] = [copy[swapIndex], copy[index]];
}
return copy;
}

function prettyDifficulty(value) {
switch (value) {
case 'easy':
return 'Easy';
case 'medium':
return 'Medium';
case 'hard':
return 'Hard';
case 'random':
return 'Random';
default:
return 'Easy';
}
}

function toTitleCase(text) {
return String(text || '')
.toLowerCase()
.replace(/\b([a-z])/g, (match) => match.toUpperCase());
}

function createCardData(settings) {
const pool = getDifficultyPool(settings.difficulty);
const requiredWords = settings.useFreeSpace ? 24 : 25;

if (pool.length < requiredWords) {
throw new Error(`There are not enough ${prettyDifficulty(settings.difficulty).toLowerCase()} bingo words to build a card. Add more words to that difficulty in the precomputed JSON or choose random mode.`);
}

const picked = shuffle(pool).slice(0, requiredWords);
const cells = picked.map((entry) => ({
word: toTitleCase(entry.word),
isFree: false
}));

if (settings.useFreeSpace) {
cells.splice(12, 0, {
word: 'FREE',
isFree: true
});
}

return {
title: `${prettyDifficulty(settings.difficulty)} Conference Bingo`,
difficulty: prettyDifficulty(settings.difficulty),
eligibleWordCount: pool.length,
totalWordCount: state.wordPools.random.length,
metadata: state.metadata,
cells
};
}

function createCardElement(card) {
const shell = document.createElement('div');
shell.className = 'gb-bingo-card-shell';

const cardElement = document.createElement('article');
cardElement.className = 'gb-bingo-card';

const header = document.createElement('div');
header.className = 'gb-bingo-card__header';

const heading = document.createElement('div');

const title = document.createElement('h3');
title.className = 'gb-bingo-card__title';
title.textContent = 'General Conference Bingo';

const meta = document.createElement('p');
meta.className = 'gb-bingo-card__eyebrow';
meta.textContent = `${card.difficulty} difficulty`;

heading.append(title, meta);

const logo = document.createElement('img');
logo.className = 'gb-bingo-card__logo';
logo.src = BINGO_CONFIG.logoUrl;
logo.alt = 'Gospel Buddy logo';
logo.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
logo.decoding = 'async';

header.append(heading, logo);

const main = document.createElement('div');
main.className = 'gb-bingo-card__main';

const gridFrame = document.createElement('div');
gridFrame.className = 'gb-bingo-grid-frame';

const grid = document.createElement('div');
grid.className = 'gb-bingo-grid';

for (const cell of card.cells) {
const cellElement = document.createElement('div');
cellElement.className = `gb-bingo-cell${cell.isFree ? ' gb-bingo-cell--free' : ''}`;

cellElement.addEventListener('click', () => {
cellElement.classList.toggle('gb-bingo-cell--selected');
});

const fitBox = document.createElement('div');
fitBox.className = 'gb-bingo-cell__fitbox';

const word = document.createElement('div');
word.className = 'gb-bingo-cell__word';
word.setAttribute('lang', 'en');
word.textContent = cell.word;

fitBox.appendChild(word);
cellElement.appendChild(fitBox);
grid.appendChild(cellElement);
}

gridFrame.appendChild(grid);
main.appendChild(gridFrame);

const footer = document.createElement('div');
footer.className = 'gb-bingo-card__footer';

const spacer = document.createElement('div');
spacer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

const footerBrand = document.createElement('div');
footerBrand.className = 'gb-bingo-card__footer-brand';

const footerText = document.createElement('span');
footerText.textContent = 'Powered by mygospelbuddy.com';

const footerLogo = document.createElement('img');
footerLogo.className = 'gb-bingo-card__footer-logo';
footerLogo.src = BINGO_CONFIG.logoUrl;
footerLogo.alt = '';
footerLogo.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
footerLogo.decoding = 'async';

footerBrand.append(footerText, footerLogo);
footer.append(spacer, footerBrand);

cardElement.append(header, main, footer);
shell.appendChild(cardElement);

return shell;
}

function sizeCardLayout(cardElement) {
if (!cardElement) {
return;
}

const cardWidth = cardElement.clientWidth;
if (!cardWidth) {
return;
}

const cardScale = cardWidth / 820;
const gridSize = 640 * cardScale;

cardElement.style.setProperty('--card-scale', String(cardScale));
cardElement.style.setProperty('--grid-size', `${gridSize}px`);
}

function fitCardWords(cardElement) {
const words = Array.from(cardElement.querySelectorAll('.gb-bingo-cell__word'));
for (const word of words) {
fitWordToCell(word);
}
}

function fitWordToCell(wordElement) {
const fitBox = wordElement.parentElement;
const cell = fitBox ? fitBox.parentElement : null;

if (!fitBox || !cell) {
return;
}

const text = (wordElement.textContent || '').trim();
const isPhrase = /\s/.test(text);

wordElement.classList.toggle('gb-bingo-cell__word--phrase', isPhrase);
wordElement.style.setProperty('--fit-scale', '1');
wordElement.style.width = isPhrase ? '100%' : 'auto';
wordElement.style.whiteSpace = isPhrase ? 'normal' : 'nowrap';

const boxWidth = fitBox.clientWidth;
const boxHeight = fitBox.clientHeight;

if (!boxWidth || !boxHeight) {
return;
}

const baseFontSize = Math.max(
8,
Math.min(
26,
Math.min(boxWidth, boxHeight) * (isPhrase ? 0.21 : 0.25)
)
);

wordElement.style.fontSize = `${baseFontSize}px`;

const naturalWidth = wordElement.scrollWidth;
const naturalHeight = wordElement.scrollHeight;

if (!naturalWidth || !naturalHeight) {
return;
}

const widthRatio = boxWidth / naturalWidth;
const heightRatio = boxHeight / naturalHeight;
const scale = Math.min(1, widthRatio, heightRatio) * 0.94;

wordElement.style.setProperty('--fit-scale', String(Math.max(0.3, scale)));
}

function observeLiveCard(cardElement) {
if (cardResizeObserver) {
cardResizeObserver.disconnect();
cardResizeObserver = null;
}

if (!window.ResizeObserver || !cardElement) {
return;
}

cardResizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
scheduleLiveCardLayout();
});

cardResizeObserver.observe(cardElement);
}

function scheduleLiveCardLayout() {
if (fitRaf) {
cancelAnimationFrame(fitRaf);
}

fitRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
const liveCard = elements.printArea.querySelector('.gb-bingo-card');
if (!liveCard) {
return;
}

sizeCardLayout(liveCard);
fitCardWords(liveCard);
});
}

function waitForImageLoad(node) {
const images = Array.from(node.querySelectorAll('img'));
if (images.length === 0) {
return Promise.resolve();
}

return Promise.all(images.map((img) => {
if (img.complete) {
return Promise.resolve();
}
return new Promise((resolve) => {
img.addEventListener('load', resolve, { once: true });
img.addEventListener('error', resolve, { once: true });
});
}));
}

function renderCurrentCard(card, settings) {
elements.printArea.innerHTML = '';
const shell = createCardElement(card);
elements.printArea.appendChild(shell);

const sessionCount = Number(card.metadata && card.metadata.totalSessions) || 0;
const sessionText = sessionCount ? ` • ${sessionCount} session(s) analyzed in preprocessing` : '';
const thresholds = card.metadata && card.metadata.thresholds ? card.metadata.thresholds : {};
const thresholdText = Number.isFinite(Number(thresholds.easySessionPercent)) && Number.isFinite(Number(thresholds.mediumSessionPercent))
? ` • Easy ${thresholds.easySessionPercent}%+ / Medium ${thresholds.mediumSessionPercent}%+`
: '';
elements.summary.textContent = `Preview example • ${card.difficulty} difficulty • ${card.eligibleWordCount} eligible word(s) • ${card.totalWordCount} total allowed word(s)${sessionText}${thresholdText}`;
state.currentCard = { card, settings };

const liveCard = shell.querySelector('.gb-bingo-card');
observeLiveCard(liveCard);

requestAnimationFrame(() => {
scheduleLiveCardLayout();
});
}

function setStatus(type, message, showSpinner = false) {
elements.status.className = `gb-status gb-status--${type} is-visible`;
elements.status.innerHTML = `${showSpinner ? '<span class="gb-status__spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>' : ''}${message}`;
}

function clearStatus() {
elements.status.className = 'gb-status';
elements.status.innerHTML = '';
}

function generateAndRenderCard(showReadyMessage) {
if (!state.ready) {
setStatus('info', 'Precomputed bingo word pools are still loading…', true);
return;
}

const settings = getSettings();

try {
setStatus('info', 'Building your bingo card…', true);
const card = createCardData(settings);
renderCurrentCard(card, settings);

if (showReadyMessage) {
setStatus('success', 'New bingo card preview ready.');
} else {
clearStatus();
}
} catch (error) {
console.error(error);
elements.printArea.innerHTML = '<div class="gb-bingo-empty">No card could be generated with those settings.</div>';
elements.summary.textContent = 'Adjust the settings and try again.';
setStatus('error', error.message || 'Gospel Buddy could not generate a bingo card.');
}
}

function createPdfCardFromLivePreview(card) {
const liveShell = elements.printArea.querySelector('.gb-bingo-card-shell');

if (!liveShell) {
throw new Error('No live bingo card is available to print.');
}

const clone = liveShell.cloneNode(true);

clone.querySelectorAll('.gb-bingo-cell--selected').forEach((node) => {
node.classList.remove('gb-bingo-cell--selected');
});

const logoImages = Array.from(clone.querySelectorAll('img'));
for (const img of logoImages) {
img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
img.decoding = 'async';
}

const clonedCard = clone.querySelector('.gb-bingo-card');
if (!clonedCard) {
throw new Error('The printable bingo card could not be prepared.');
}

const liveCard = liveShell.querySelector('.gb-bingo-card');
const liveWidth = liveCard ? liveCard.getBoundingClientRect().width : 0;

elements.pdfStage.innerHTML = '';
elements.pdfStage.style.width = `${Math.ceil(Math.max(1, liveShell.getBoundingClientRect().width))}px`;
elements.pdfStage.appendChild(clone);

if (liveWidth > 0) {
clonedCard.style.width = `${liveWidth}px`;
clonedCard.style.maxWidth = `${liveWidth}px`;
}

sizeCardLayout(clonedCard);
fitCardWords(clonedCard);

return clone;
}

async function exportPdfBatch() {
if (!state.ready) {
return;
}

const settings = getSettings();
const totalCards = settings.pdfCount;
const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;

setStatus('info', `Creating ${totalCards} bingo PDF page${totalCards === 1 ? '' : 's'}…`, true);
elements.pdfStage.innerHTML = '';

try {
const pdf = new jsPDF({
orientation: 'portrait',
unit: 'pt',
format: 'letter'
});

for (let index = 0; index < totalCards; index += 1) {
let node;

if (index === 0 && state.currentCard && state.currentCard.card) {
node = createPdfCardFromLivePreview(state.currentCard.card);
} else {
const card = createCardData(settings);
renderCurrentCard(card, settings);
await waitForNextFrame();
await waitForNextFrame();
node = createPdfCardFromLivePreview(card);
}

await waitForNextFrame();
await waitForImageLoad(node);
await waitForNextFrame();

const canvas = await html2canvas(node, {
backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
scale: 2,
useCORS: true
});

const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
const pageWidth = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
const pageHeight = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
const margin = 28;

const ratio = Math.min(
(pageWidth - margin * 2) / canvas.width,
(pageHeight - margin * 2) / canvas.height
);

const renderWidth = canvas.width * ratio;
const renderHeight = canvas.height * ratio;
const offsetX = (pageWidth - renderWidth) / 2;
const offsetY = (pageHeight - renderHeight) / 2;

if (index > 0) {
pdf.addPage();
}

pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', offsetX, offsetY, renderWidth, renderHeight, undefined, 'FAST');
elements.pdfStage.innerHTML = '';
}

const safeDifficulty = prettyDifficulty(settings.difficulty).toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-');
const safePages = totalCards === 1 ? '1-page' : `${totalCards}-pages`;
pdf.save(`general-conference-bingo-${safeDifficulty}-${safePages}.pdf`);
setStatus('success', `PDF ready: ${totalCards} bingo page${totalCards === 1 ? '' : 's'} generated.`);
} catch (error) {
console.error(error);
setStatus('error', 'Gospel Buddy could not create the bingo PDF. Please try again.');
} finally {
elements.pdfStage.innerHTML = '';
}
}

function waitForNextFrame() {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
window.requestAnimationFrame(resolve);
});
});
}
</script>
